Rentals, in detail

What each vehicle is like on the road, and the trips it suits best.

Tempo Traveller on Rent in Madhira

For group travel, nothing beats keeping everyone in one vehicle. Our Tempo Travellers come in 9, 12, 17 and 26-seater sizes, so a cousins' trip, an office team or a full darshan group all fit without splitting into separate cars.

Push-back seats, proper legroom, a high roof you can stand up in, and full air-conditioning make long runs — Tirupati, Srisailam, Hyderabad or Vijayawada — comfortable instead of tiring. There is generous space for bags, and your driver handles the route, the fuel stops and the parking while you travel with your group.

Book by the hour, by the day, or per kilometre — the fare is confirmed upfront on call, with no hidden charges added later.

Call 88972 35407

Force Urbania on Rent in Madhira

The Urbania is the premium way to move a group — a new-generation van with a tall, airy cabin, reclining seats for 10 to 17 passengers, individual AC vents and a noticeably quieter ride than a regular traveller.

It is the right pick for receiving important guests, corporate offsites, wedding parties and elders who need an easy, comfortable journey on multi-day trips like Tirupati / Tirumala darshan. The high roof means no stooping, and the wide seats mean nobody arrives worn out.

Hourly, daily and multi-day packages are available — tell us your plan and we will quote one clear price.

Call 88972 35407

Mini Bus on Rent in Madhira

For the biggest groups, a mini bus keeps the whole party together — one vehicle, one driver, one plan. School and college trips, wedding guests, community functions and large family events all run simpler this way.

Wide seating, an easy step-in entry and room for everyone's luggage make it practical for both short local runs and full-day outstation trips across Andhra Pradesh and Telangana.

Ertiga Taxi from Madhira

Our own white Ertiga (TG04T8181) is the car Madhira calls first — a clean, well-kept 7-seater with five years of trips behind it. Families take it for Tirupati / Tirumala darshan, professionals take it for business runs to Hyderabad, Vijayawada and Bengaluru, and everyone takes it when the trip simply has to start on time.
